svg.title: Bakuhatsu — Doctrine of Detonation. Draft 1 / Explosion classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 9 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Primed Fuse forks into Shaped Charge then Ground Zero, or Powder Keg. Smoke and Shrapnel forks into Hardened Casing then Siege Battery, or Slow Burn then Chain Reaction. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Explosion-classified Bakuhatsu jutsu.

BUFF","adverse":false,"base":35.0,"gain":4,"final":39.0,"calculation":"percentage","supported":true,"capped_at_100":false}],"advanced_arts":["Siege Battery"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":"Nine nodes rather than ten. The kit's five supported tags (Damage 3 rows, Increase Damage Given 2, Increase Damage Taken 1, Decrease Damage Taken 1, Afterburn 1) give three distinct Advanced routes (burst, pressure, fortified). The only unused candidate for a fourth capstone is Increase Damage Taken, which sits on the same Charge 4 Explosion cast, target and two-round window as the Afterburn route; a second capstone there would duplicate the pressure route rather than add a choice. Powder Keg is kept as a leaf Hidden Art so the burst route has an all-in fourth purchase and the charge buffs have an owner. Three complete builds are distinct.","design_notes":["Node split: the two roots mirror the kit's two support casts. Primed Fuse (Charge 4 Explosion self buff and exposure, Howitzer Crash ground buff) forks into the Damage route (Shaped Charge \u2192 Ground Zero) and the leaf Hidden Art Powder Keg. Smoke and Shrapnel (Blast Shield reduction, Charge 4 Explosion Afterburn) forks into Fortify (Hardened Casing \u2192 Siege Battery) and Pressure (Slow Burn \u2192 Chain Reaction). 2 Foundations, 4 Hidden Arts, 3 Advanced Arts; each capstone 3 BP deep, any two 5\u20136 BP.","Flats follow coverage. Damage reaches three rows and mirrors the reference (+2 Hidden, +3 Advanced, max +5). Increase Damage Given reaches two rows, so its build maximum is +5 (Fuse 2 + Keg 3, or Fuse 2 + Battery 2); Battery's +2 secondary sits below Keg's +3. Increase Damage Taken is one row, max +5 (Fuse 2 + Chain Reaction 3), under the reference's +7. Decrease Damage Taken takes the single-row 2/3/5 ladder (Blast Shield 45%). Afterburn is split 2/3/5 to reach exactly the +10 ceiling (45%).","Main tree and passives: both Increase Damage Given rows filter the Highest stat with no element, so for two rounds they multiply every element-less hit of any stat type (basic attacks, weapons, non-elemental jutsu) and Highest-stat elemental hits. The exposure row lists Earth/Explosion/Lightning/None, so ally and weapon damage of those elements or none is raised. Afterburn and Blast Shield rows list all four stat types, no element: every non-pierce hit.","Delivery and uptime: all five jutsu have cooldown 7. Damage casts cost 60 AP (Inferno Cataclysm spiral at a ground tile, range 4; Kinetic Nova circle spawn on a target, range 4; Howitzer Crash circle spawn on empty ground, range 5, which also moves the caster). Charge 4 Explosion: 40 AP, single target, range 4, three rows for two rounds. Blast Shield: 40 AP range-1 circle shoot, friendly fire ALL, so allies inside share it. Howitzer's buff is a ground row the caster reaches from the next round.","Fourth purchase choices: Burst takes Powder Keg (Increase Damage Given +5 total, all-in) or Smoke and Shrapnel (reduction +2, Afterburn +2); Pressure takes Primed Fuse (self buff +2, exposure +5 total) or Hardened Casing (reduction +5); Fortified takes Primed Fuse (self buff +4, exposure +2) or Slow Burn (Afterburn +5). Hybrids with no Advanced Art (Fuse, Keg, Shrapnel, Casing) spread smaller gains across four tags. Keg and Battery cannot be bought together (5 BP), keeping the two-row tag at +5.","Afterburn at the route maximum (45%) stays under the 60%-per-hit cap while it is the only Afterburn source on the target; any second Afterburn source saturates the remaining 15 points. Unsupported rows (Inferno Cataclysm recoil, Kinetic Nova wound, Blast Shield barrier, Howitzer Crash move) are unchanged by every node; the trait text 'AoE Control' is carried by those unsupported rows and the area shapes, not by any potency row, so no node addresses it."],"risks":["Single-cast concentration: Chain Reaction raises both Charge 4 Explosion debuff rows (Afterburn 45%, exposure 38\u201340%) and Primed Fuse / Powder Keg / Siege Battery raise its self buff, so one 40 AP C-rank cast can carry three enhanced rows at once. Per-AP value of that cast rises more than the 60 AP damage route's; no combat simulation was run.","Leakage: the enhanced Increase Damage Given rows multiply normal jutsu, weapon and basic-attack damage that passes their Highest-stat or element-less filter while active; the exposure and Afterburn debuffs raise damage dealt by allies and weapons to the charged target; Blast Shield's enhanced reduction also protects allies in its circle. Casting scope does not restrict downstream benefit.","Afterburn value is downstream: it depends on how many non-pierce hits the charged target takes during the two-round window, and cumulative Afterburn per hit is capped at 60% of that hit, so a 45% debuff leaves only 15 points for any other Afterburn source. Pierce hits are skipped by Afterburn and by the exposure modifier alike.","Howitzer Crash's Increase Damage Given row is a ground effect: because the jutsu's move row sorts last, the caster receives the buff only from the round after landing and only while standing in the circle, and allies in the circle receive it too. Powder Keg and Siege Battery values on that row are positional; the Charge 4 Explosion self-buff row is the reliable one.","Friendly fire: the three damage rows carry friendly fire ENEMIES, so the Damage route does not raise damage to allies in the areas. Kinetic Nova's wound row (friendly fire none, ally hazard) is unsupported and untouched by every node. Blast Shield's friendly fire ALL means its enhanced reduction and unsupported barrier land on allies in the circle; beneficial, not a hazard.","Classification: the Explosion label collides with Bakuhatsu Suru Nendo (DEFER) in the census and the normal-jutsu collision is unverified, so eligibility must be bloodline-scoped, not a bare element match. Under the current resolver only 4 of 8 supported rows (three damage rows, the exposure row) match Explosion directly; both self buffs, the Afterburn row and the shield row fall back to None.","Both Increase Damage Given rows and Blast Shield's reduction are percentage rows at 35% base; the route maxima (40% and 45%) are far from the 100 cap, but each is a two-round buff that must be cast inside the engagement window, so realised uptime, not the flat, decides their value.","Ranked PvP and ranked sparring suppress skill-tree effects at the pin, so the whole tree is inert there. Normal-tree potency policy is not approved; a combined stacking audit is still required before any implementation."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":9,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":4,"advanced_art_count":3,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":5,"3":9,"4":12},"full_budget_allocations":12,"non_dominated_full_allocations":12,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":5,"increasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":5,"decreasedamagetaken":10,"afterburn":10},"supported_rows_in_kit":8,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"afterburn":1,"damage":3,"decreasedamagetaken":1,"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":1},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["afterburn","damage","decreasedamagetaken","increasedamagegiven","increasedamagetaken"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Draft 1 / Explosion classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed potency classification behavior; g.text: Draft 1 / Explosion classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Bakuhatsu jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · AB: Afterburn
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Afterburn is an enemy debuff: while it lasts, damage the target takes adds Afterburn damage at the debuff percentage (60% cap per hit).
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
12 legal four-skill allocations · 3 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
